environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance behind a classic ELB (TCP passthrough mode) in a public subnet. Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or proxy filtering. The Flask application handles all HTTP traffic directly. Database contains user records including api_key column with production API keys.

config.load_balancer: Classic ELB, TCP passthrough on port 8080
config.database_content: users table populated with api_key values for all users
